question: Should maintainers port and land this direct WebChat Stop recovery on top of the current ui/src/pages/chat refactor, while keeping compaction and channel-specific Stop variants separate?
rationale: The implementation is correct and proven against its PR head, but current main moved the UI chat surface and the change alters persisted lifecycle terminalization, so automation should not choose the owner invariant or adoption strategy alone.

options.title: Port Direct Stop Recovery
options.body: Apply the local abort reconciliation and startedAt stale-run lifecycle guard to current main's chat/lifecycle files, then rerun WebChat Stop proof and focused Gateway/UI tests.

options.title: Broaden Before Merge
options.body: Require this branch to also cover the compaction/restartRecoveryRuns context-loss variant before landing, with a new reproduction or regression for that path.

options.title: Pause For Unified Session Design
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want a single broader run-generation owner for Stop, restart recovery, channel sessions, and compaction races.

recommendation.title: Port Direct Stop Recovery
recommendation.body: Apply the local abort reconciliation and startedAt stale-run lifecycle guard to current main's chat/lifecycle files, then rerun WebChat Stop proof and focused Gateway/UI tests.
